findings.title: Bind follow-up source coverage to trusted inventory
findings.detail: sourceHashes is compared only with baseline sourceHashes, whose baseline hash is supplied by the same manifest. No required source set is derived or checked against state.inventory/baseQuestion. The fixture explicitly accepts empty baseline/review sourceHashes and no source-file validation executes. Existing load_workspace protects global canonical sources, so this does not by itself permit modifying those originals, but the new approval is not bound to its required original image/answer-key/source evidence.
findings.reproduction: Current tests/ap-hint-revisions.py fixture has sourceHashes:{} in both baseline and review; approved followup passes.
findings.recommendation: Require base.sourceHashes to match trusted inventory sourceHashes (or derive the complete required source set), then retain actual-file validation. Add omission/empty-map and changed-file tests.

findings.title: Preserve transcription_transition before/after reconstruction
findings.detail: expected_material now always applies followups, including corrections=False used by transcription_transition at line 340. A followup approved against a corrected question cannot match the pre-correction question, so expected_material(state, corrections=False) raises Stale follow-up baseline. This prevents the prior transcription transition API from reconstructing its before object once such a question receives a followup.
findings.reproduction: Synthetic existing fixture: set sourceCorrections for x, freeze followup baseQuestion to corrected choices/version; expected_material(state) succeeds, expected_material(state,corrections=False) fails Stale follow-up baseline: x.
findings.recommendation: Make transcription_transition explicitly handle followups while reconstructing its accepted before/after states; add a corrected-question plus registered-followup regression test.

findings.title: Reject blank or nontext design and review evidence
findings.detail: New design/reasoning checks use truthiness, unlike old _check_batch nonempty-string validation. notes=" ", independentResult=true, obstacle=" ", candidateDecision=true, and stage newInformation=" ", remainingWork=true, reason=["not prose"] all pass exact approval and publication gate. Such records do not preserve meaningful author/reviewer evidence.
findings.reproduction: Mutate existing Followup fixture to listed values, save and apply; accepted.
findings.recommendation: Enforce nonblank strings for narrative fields, recognized candidateDecision values, and existing independentResult type requirements. Add rejection tests.

positiveChecks: Only named registered followup rounds are read; unregistered folders are ignored.
Each review binds baseline lesson, baseline full question and final lesson SHA256.
Only hints can differ in lesson; all other question fields are retained and version increments once per changed registered round during a rebuild.
Existing initial-batch registration and review logic is unchanged.
coverageGaps: No multi-round chain or stale-question test
No actual nonempty source-file hash modification test
No correction plus followup interoperability test
